description: Run a listing on a cron and get one signed webhook per run with only the new, changed (field-level previous/current plus provenance) and removed entities. The monthly cap is hard: the feed stops (status capped) rather than exceed it, and only valid results are billed. Returns the feed, its expected monthly cost and the webhook secret once. Set preset to new-merchant-radar (slug maps-places) or business-contact-refresh (slug website-contacts) for AlterLab Official defaults. Schedules more frequent than the server minimum interval (60 minutes by default) are rejected with a 422.

cron_expression.description: Five-field cron; required unless a preset supplies it. Must not fire more often than every 60 minutes (server minimum)

delivery_mode.description: delta sends only changes, full sends every result. Default: delta

input.description: Listing input; validated against the listing input_schema

monthly_cap_microcents.description: Hard monthly spend cap in microcents

webhook_url.description: https URL that receives the delta
